tokyo_tempura_tenhide.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. All figures are from the shop's own お品書き pages and are stated there to be tax-included. The shop notes course contents change with the season and the market, and that the white-wine list is only on the in-store card.

items.en: 'S' course — small dish, sashimi, one cooked dish, 10 kinds of tempura, rice course (tendon or ten-cha), dessert, plus a choice of finishing dish. The shop's own headline course
items.note: Tempura batter is wheat flour and the whole kitchen is a tempura kitchen with one shared oil pot. The house 天つゆ has been topped up from the founding — a soy-sauce-based dipping broth, so wheat again. 天丼/天茶 both put that soy tsuyu on rice.

items.ja: 天ぷら おまかせコース
items.en: Tempura omakase — small dish, sashimi, one cooked dish, 12 kinds of tempura, rice course (tendon or ten-cha), dessert. The longest course
items.note: Wheat batter throughout, shared oil, soy-based tentsuyu. Sashimi course means fish.

items.en: 'A' course — small dish, 12 kinds of tempura, rice course (tendon or ten-cha), dessert
items.note: Wheat batter, shared fryer, soy tentsuyu.

items.en: 'B' course — small dish, 10 kinds of tempura, rice course (tendon or ten-cha), dessert. The entry-level course
items.note: Wheat batter, shared fryer, soy tentsuyu.

items.en: Tempura over rice in a lacquered box, with miso soup, pickles and dessert — the lunch mainstay (also sold to take away)
items.note: Large portion +¥120. Wheat batter and the soy-based house tentsuyu poured over the rice. Miso soup in a tempura shop is dashi (bonito) plus miso.

items.en: Kakiage rice bowl — a fritter of small prawns bound in batter, with miso soup, pickles and dessert
items.note: Large portion +¥120. Kakiage is loose batter by definition — wheat flour is the binder — plus prawns and soy tsuyu.

items.en: Tempura set meal — rolled prawn, shiso-wrapped prawn, three vegetables, two seafood, kakiage; rice (free refills), miso soup, pickles, dessert
items.note: Large portion +¥120. Everything on the plate is wheat-battered and fried in the same oil. Also sold as takeout, order five days ahead, pickup 11:30–13:30 weekdays only.

items.ja: アサヒスーパードライ 中瓶
items.en: Asahi Super Dry, medium bottle
items.note: Beer is brewed from barley malt, a gluten grain.

items.ja: サッポロ黒ラベル 中瓶
items.en: Sapporo Black Label, medium bottle
items.note: Barley malt beer.

items.en: Kirin Zero Ichi non-alcoholic beer
items.note: Alcohol-free but still brewed from barley malt — not gluten-free.

items.en: Fresh-squeezed lemon sour
items.note: Shochu, soda and fresh lemon. Depends entirely on which shochu base is used — a 麦 (barley) shochu would be a gluten grain, so ask which spirit goes in.

items.en: Pickled-plum sour
items.note: Same question — the shochu base is unstated.

items.en: Green-tea highball (shochu with green tea)
items.note: Green tea carries no barley (unlike 麦茶), but the shochu base is unstated — ask.

items.en: Oolong highball (shochu with oolong tea)
items.note: Oolong is a tea leaf, not a grain. The shochu base is unstated.

items.en: Hyakushu sweet-potato shochu, 25%, Kagoshima — glass ¥660 / bottle ¥5,170
items.section: お飲み物 Drinks — 焼酎 shochu
items.note: Sweet-potato shochu — the base grain is not barley. Distillation aside, koji for imo shochu is commonly grown on rice; the shop states no allergen information, so ask. Soda mixer +¥66.

items.en: Kicchomu barley shochu, 25%, Oita — glass ¥770 / bottle ¥6,600
items.section: お飲み物 Drinks — 焼酎 shochu
items.note: 麦 = barley. A barley shochu is made from a gluten grain and is never treated as gluten-free here. Soda mixer +¥66.

items.ja: メローこずるエクセレンス41℃（鹿児島・米）
items.en: Mellow Kozuru Excellence rice shochu, 41%, Kagoshima — glass ¥950 / bottle ¥9,900
items.section: お飲み物 Drinks — 焼酎 shochu
items.note: Rice-based shochu, so no barley in the name — but the shop publishes no ingredient statement. Soda mixer +¥66.

items.ja: 岩井トラディション40℃（日本）
items.en: Iwai Tradition Japanese whisky, 40% — single ¥660 / double ¥1,320
items.section: お飲み物 Drinks — ウイスキー whisky
items.note: Whisky is distilled from malted barley. Malt drinks are not treated as gluten-free in this app.

items.ja: モンキーショルダー40℃（スコッチ）
items.en: Monkey Shoulder blended malt Scotch, 40% — single ¥880 / double ¥1,720
items.section: お飲み物 Drinks — ウイスキー whisky
items.note: A blended malt — barley. Not gluten-free.

items.en: Komasa plum liqueur
items.section: お飲み物 Drinks — 梅酒 plum wine
items.note: Plum liqueur; the spirit base is unstated and umeshu is frequently built on either brandy or shochu, so ask. Soda mixer +¥66.

items.ja: 黒松白鹿 特選本醸造（兵庫）
items.en: Kuromatsu Hakushika honjozo sake, served warm or at room temperature — 1 go ¥770 / 2 go ¥1,540; also as a 300 ml chilled bottle at ¥1,320
items.section: お飲み物 Drinks — 日本酒 sake
items.note: Sake is brewed from rice and rice koji; honjozo has a small addition of distilled alcohol, base unstated. No barley in the recipe, but the shop publishes no allergen statement.

items.ja: 億の松 生貯蔵酒（福島）
items.en: Oku no Matsu nama-chozo sake, chilled 300 ml bottle
items.section: お飲み物 Drinks — 日本酒 sake
items.note: Rice sake. The shop lists about ten sakes seasonally sourced from a Toyosu merchant; the full list is only on the in-store card.

items.en: Soda mixer for bottle-keep

items.note: Carbonated water.

items.ja: 割り用緑茶デキャンタ

items.section: お飲み物 Drinks — 割り物 mixers

items.en: Ice for bottle-keep

tokyo_book_house_cafe.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Taken verbatim from the shop's own カフェ page. Any food or sweet can have a drink added for +¥300 from the listed drink range. Café hours 11:00–17:30 weekdays (LO 17:00), 11:00–18:00 weekends and holidays (LO 17:30); the back-room bar Lilliput runs 20:00–23:00 on weekdays with a ¥500 cover.

items.en: Japanese-style bento box
items.note: The shop publishes no contents or allergen list for the box. A Japanese bento is assembled from soy-simmered and soy-dressed items and normally includes something fried — assume wheat, and ask what is actually inside on the day.

items.ja: ビーフとチーズの特製カレー
items.romaji: beef to cheese no tokusei curry
items.en: House curry with beef and cheese
items.note: Japanese curry roux is thickened with wheat flour as standard. Beef and cheese besides.

items.ja: おこさまカレー（選べるドリンク付き）
items.en: Children's curry, with a choice of drink included (orange juice, apple juice or barley tea)
items.note: Wheat-thickened curry roux. Note the drink options: 麦茶 is barley tea, which is a gluten grain — the two juices are the wheat-free choices here.

items.ja: こんがりチーズの焼きハヤシ
items.en: Baked hayashi rice under browned cheese
items.note: Hayashi (hashed-beef) sauce is a demi-glace — wheat-flour roux — and there is dairy.

items.ja: 昔懐かしいナポリタン
items.en: Old-fashioned Napolitan — ketchup-fried spaghetti
items.note: Spaghetti is durum wheat. Japanese Napolitan is normally made with ham or sausage and finished with butter.

items.en: Hamburg steak with hayashi sauce
items.note: Japanese hamburg patties are bound with panko breadcrumbs and egg, and hayashi sauce is a wheat-roux demi-glace.

items.ja: アボカド入りサーモンサンド
items.en: Salmon and avocado sandwich
items.note: Bread. Salmon.

items.en: Ham on toast
items.note: Bread and ham.

items.en: Curry bread — deep-fried bun filled with curry
items.note: Bread dough, panko coating and wheat-roux curry filling, deep-fried.

items.en: Coffee
items.section: ドリンクメニュー Drinks
items.note: Black coffee is naturally free of gluten and animal products; what is unknown is whether it is poured in a kitchen that also handles the sandwiches and toast. Ask for it black if dairy matters.

items.en: American (weak) coffee
items.section: ドリンクメニュー Drinks
items.note: Diluted drip coffee.

items.en: Caffè latte
items.section: ドリンクメニュー Drinks

items.en: Hot cocoa

items.en: Caffè mocha

items.en: Iced rosehip herb tea

items.en: Orange juice

items.en: Children's drink — choice of orange juice, apple juice or barley tea

items.en: Melon cream soda with ice cream

items.en: Lemon squash

items.en: Beer, served with a small snack

items.ja: ワイン（赤／白）（おつまみ付き）
items.en: Wine, red or white, served with a small snack
items.section: ドリンクメニュー Drinks
items.note: Grape wine carries no gluten grain, but wines are often fined with isinglass, gelatin or egg white and the shop names no producer. The included snack is unspecified.

items.ja: プレミアムソフトクリーム（バニラ／抹茶／チョコレート）

items.en: Madeleine

items.ja: ブックバー リリパット チャージ

tokyo_awkitchen_figlia_shibuya.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. From the branch's own menu sheets on aw-kitchen.com: the '2026 Summer' dinner card and the 2026/07 lunch and café PDFs. Prices are shown pre-tax with the tax-included figure in brackets on the sheet; the figure given here is the tax-included one. A ¥220 seat charge applies per person from 17:00. The shop states contents and prices change with what the farms send. Shibuya Scramble Square 13F, 11:00–16:30 / 17:00–23:00 daily.

items.ja: AW農園バーニャカウダ（2名様分）
items.en: AW farm bagna cauda for two — raw and blanched seasonal vegetables with the house creamy anchovy-garlic dip. The chain's signature dish
items.section: SALAD 畑を味わうサラダ
items.note: Bagna cauda is built on anchovy, garlic and cream or butter — fish and dairy, so not vegan. The shop calls it a 特製ソース and publishes no recipe; bagna cauda normally has no wheat, but the same kitchen makes fresh wheat pasta daily and the shop's own notice says all cookware and the dishwasher are shared, so a coeliac must ask.

items.ja: 季節野菜と奈良県山口農園の有機野菜のガーデンサラダ
items.romaji: kisetsu yasai to Nara Yamaguchi-nouen no yuki-yasai no garden salad
items.en: Garden salad of seasonal vegetables and organic vegetables from Yamaguchi Farm in Nara
items.section: SALAD 畑を味わうサラダ
items.note: Vegetables only in the name; the dressing is not described, and Italian-restaurant dressings often carry cheese, anchovy or soy. Ask for the dressing composition and for it on the side. Shared kitchen with fresh wheat pasta.

items.ja: ロメインレタスとベーコンのシーザーサラダ
items.romaji: romaine lettuce to bacon no Caesar salad
items.en: Caesar salad with romaine lettuce and bacon
items.section: SALAD 畑を味わうサラダ
items.note: Bacon and a Caesar dressing (egg, anchovy, parmesan). Caesar salads are served with croutons as standard and the shop bakes baguette on the same menu — treat as wheat unless the kitchen confirms otherwise.

items.ja: AW定番！イカ墨と胡桃のバゲット、たっぷりトマトのブルスケッタ
items.romaji: ika-sumi to kurumi no baguette, tappuri tomato no bruschetta
items.en: The AW standard — squid-ink and walnut baguette bruschetta piled with tomato
items.note: Baguette — wheat. Squid ink, and walnut (a declarable allergen in Japan).

items.ja: 燻製いぶりがっことクリームチーズのポテトサラダ
items.romaji: kunsei iburigakko to cream cheese no potato salad
items.en: Potato salad with smoked iburigakko daikon pickle and cream cheese
items.note: Cream cheese and normally mayonnaise (egg) — not vegan. Potato and pickle carry no wheat in themselves, but iburigakko is sometimes brined with soy, and the kitchen is shared; ask.

items.ja: プロシュートとブラータチーズ
items.en: Prosciutto with burrata
items.note: Cured pork and fresh cheese. Neither contains wheat as a rule, but Italian plates arrive with bread as standard and the kitchen is shared — ask for it served without bread.

items.ja: 鮮魚のカルパッチョ 〜季節のフルーツとシチリア産オリーブオイルで〜
items.en: Fresh fish carpaccio with seasonal fruit and Sicilian olive oil
items.note: Raw fish — not vegan. Dressed in olive oil and fruit rather than a sauce, so this is one of the better things to ask about; the shop warns that its seafood may carry traces of shrimp and crab. Also available as the lunch appetiser for +¥275.

items.ja: 長野ベリーファームのカラフルトマトとブラータチーズのカプレーゼ
items.romaji: Nagano Berry Farm no colorful tomato to burrata cheese no caprese
items.en: Caprese of coloured tomatoes from Nagano Berry Farm with burrata
items.note: Fresh cheese — not vegan. Tomato, cheese and oil carry no wheat, but shared cookware applies.

items.ja: 米茄子としらすのピザ風オーブン焼き
items.romaji: beinasu to shirasu no pizza-fu oven-yaki
items.en: Oven-baked American eggplant with whitebait, pizza style
items.note: Shirasu (whitebait) and melted cheese. 'Pizza style' here describes the topping on eggplant rather than a base, but confirm no breadcrumb gratin topping.

items.ja: サルシッチャソーセージ 〜ナポリ風カポナータ添え〜
items.en: Salsiccia sausage with Neapolitan caponata
items.note: Pork sausage. Sausage fillings frequently use breadcrumb or wheat-starch binder and the shop publishes no ingredient list — ask.

items.ja: お野菜たっぷりオムレツ
items.en: Vegetable-packed omelette
items.note: Egg — not vegan. An omelette itself need not contain wheat; the shop gives no ingredient line.

items.ja: 旬のお野菜と小海老のアヒージョ
items.romaji: shun no oyasai to koebi no ajillo
items.en: Seasonal vegetables and small prawns in garlic oil (ajillo)
items.note: Prawns. Ajillo is oil, garlic and chilli, normally wheat-free — but it is served to be mopped up with the baguette, so ask for it without bread, and note the shop's warning that its seafood may carry shrimp and crab traces.

items.en: Baguette, two slices
items.note: Wheat bread.

items.ja: フレッシュトマトとバジルのポモドーロ［トマトを練りこんだタリアテッレ］

items.en: Pomodoro with fresh tomatoes and basil, on tomato-kneaded tagliatelle — dinner ¥1,749, lunch set from ¥1,859. Burrata topping +¥550
items.section: FRESH PASTA 自家製生パスタ
items.note: House-made fresh pasta — the shop announced on 2026-06-19 that all its fresh pasta is now made in-house. Fresh Italian pasta is wheat flour and is normally enriched with egg, and here the dough itself is kneaded with tomato. Sauce is tomato and basil, so vegan is worth asking about only if the pasta dough is eggless — which the shop does not state.

items.ja: 北海道 尾藤さんのじゃが芋とインゲンのジェノベーゼ［ほうれん草を練りこんだタリアテッレ］

items.section: FRESH PASTA 自家製生パスタ
items.note: Wheat pasta. Genovese (basil pesto) contains pecorino or parmesan and often pine nuts — dairy, so not vegan.

items.ja: ずわい蟹と山口農園の有機ルッコラのトマトクリームソース［ほうれん草を練りこんだタリアテッレ］
items.romaji: zuwaigani to Yamaguchi-nouen no yuki rucola no tomato cream sauce
items.en: Snow crab and organic rocket in tomato cream sauce, on spinach tagliatelle

items.ja: 長野県産とうもろこし『ゴールドラッシュ』と青唐辛子のペペロンチーノ［キターラ］
items.romaji: Nagano-ken-san tomorokoshi Gold Rush to aotogarashi no peperoncino
items.en: Peperoncino with Nagano 'Gold Rush' sweetcorn and green chilli, on chitarra — dinner ¥1,815, lunch set from ¥1,925

items.en: Large pasta portion, 1.5× (long pasta 150 g / short pasta 100 g)

items.ja: ガトーショコラ バニラアイス添え

items.en: Rich broth tsukemen with a seasoned soft-boiled egg
items.note: 小麦・卵 on the shop's chart. Wheat noodles; the ajitama is marinated in soy-sauce tare (wheat).

items.note: 小麦・卵 on the shop's chart. Wheat noodles and soy-braised pork.

items.en: Rich broth tsukemen topped with pulled (shredded) special char siu pork

items.ja: 濃厚チャーシューつけ麺
items.en: Rich broth tsukemen with sliced char siu pork — marked RECOMMEND on the card

items.en: Rich broth ramen — the same thick pork-and-fish soup served as a hot noodle bowl
items.note: 小麦・卵 on the shop's own chart. Wheat noodles, soy tare.

items.en: Rich broth ramen with seasoned soft-boiled egg
items.note: 小麦・卵 on the shop's chart.

items.en: Special rich broth ramen — loaded, with egg and extra pork

items.en: Rich broth ramen with pulled special char siu pork
items.note: 小麦・卵 on the shop's chart.

items.ja: 濃厚チャーシューらーめん
items.en: Rich broth ramen with sliced char siu pork
items.note: Wheat noodles and soy-braised pork; same 濃厚らーめん base, marked 小麦・卵.

items.en: Plain white rice
items.note: The one dish with NO allergen marked at all on つじ田's own 28-allergen chart — plain steamed rice, no soy sauce. Still 'ask' rather than 'gf' because the same chart's header states the kitchen cannot exclude allergen ingredients and all dishes share cooking equipment with wheat noodles; a rice bowl handed across a tsukemen counter is a cross-contact risk. Vegan 'ask' only for handling, the rice itself is plain.

items.en: Small rice / rice refill
items.note: Same plain rice in a smaller bowl (the ticket machine calls it 替え飯). Unmarked on the allergen chart; same shared-kitchen caveat as 白ごはん.

items.en: Rice with pickled leaf-mustard greens
items.note: Marked 小麦 (wheat) on the shop's own allergen chart — the takana seasoning carries soy sauce. Also marked ごま/大豆/豚肉 further along the row.

items.en: Char siu pork rice bowl
items.note: Marked 小麦 on the shop's own chart — the pork is braised in wheat soy sauce.

items.en: Japanese greens topping (spinach and komatsuna)
items.note: Plain blanched greens; not separately listed on the allergen chart, so no per-item evidence either way. Ask whether they are dressed or blanched in the noodle water.

items.ja: 佐賀県有明海産 一番摘み海苔
items.en: First-harvest nori seaweed from the Ariake Sea, Saga Prefecture
items.note: Plain dried nori sheets by the shop's own description; nori itself is naturally free of gluten and animal products, but the shop publishes no ingredient line for it and it is served into a wheat-noodle bowl.

items.en: Wood-ear mushroom
items.note: No allergen line published for this topping. Wood-ear is usually rehydrated and seasoned; seasoning normally means soy sauce, so ask.

items.en: Chopped scallion
items.note: Raw scallion. Not separately listed on the allergen chart; the risk is the shared prep surface, not the ingredient.

items.en: Sudachi citrus — squeezed into the noodles a third of the way through, per the shop's printed 'how to eat' card
items.note: A cut citrus fruit. No allergen line published. The shop's counter card (つじ田つけ麺流儀) instructs squeezing it over the noodles at the one-third mark.

items.en: Seasoned bamboo shoots

items.en: Seasoned soft-boiled egg
items.note: Egg, and marinated in soy-sauce tare (wheat). 卵 is marked wherever this appears on the shop's chart.

items.en: One slice of char siu pork

items.en: Pulled special char siu pork

items.en: Tsukemen, extra-large noodle portion (surcharge)

items.en: Black oolong tea (bottled)
items.note: Oolong is a tea leaf, not a grain — unlike 麦茶 it carries no barley. Bottled product, so the brand's own label is the authority; the shop publishes none.

items.en: 'Cheese-toro' — melted cheese over minced fatty tuna or beef, the house speed-snack
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Dairy. Composition not published; izakaya versions are finished with a soy-based tare, so ask.

items.en: Fried chicken karaage
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Karaage is marinated in soy sauce and dusted in wheat flour or a flour/potato-starch blend, then fried in oil shared with breaded items on this menu.

items.en: Fried chicken cartilage
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Same soy marinade, same flour dusting, same shared fryer.

items.en: Fried chicken wings
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Nagoya-style wings are fried then glazed with a soy-and-mirin tare — wheat both ways.

items.en: Salted green soybeans in the pod
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Boiled and salted soybeans — normally nothing but beans, water and salt, which makes this one of the few plant-only dishes here. No allergen statement is published and the kitchen deep-fries wheat, so ask.

items.ja: やみつきガーリックシュリンプ
items.en: 'Addictive' garlic shrimp
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Prawns. Garlic-butter shrimp need not contain wheat, but Japanese versions are frequently dusted in flour before the pan — ask.

items.en: Rolled dashi omelette
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Egg — not vegan. The dashi in a commercial dashimaki is almost always 白だし or めんつゆ, which are soy-sauce based and therefore wheat, and bonito besides. A classic dish that looks safe and is not.

items.en: Fried octopus
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Flour-dusted and fried; soy in the marinade.

items.en: Stir-fried cabbage
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Cabbage in a pan. Almost every Japanese stir-fry is seasoned with soy sauce and many use a dashi or oyster-sauce base — ask what goes in before treating it as either.

items.en: Breaded fried salmon
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: フライ means panko breadcrumbs — wheat — and it comes with tartare or a wheat-containing sauce.

items.ja: サーモンカルパッチョ
items.en: Salmon carpaccio (quick-menu portion)
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Raw fish. Carpaccio dressing here is undocumented; Japanese versions often use a soy-and-olive-oil dressing, so ask.

items.en: Tuna carpaccio
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Raw fish; dressing undocumented, likely soy-based.

items.en: Fried mehikari (greeneye) — small whole deep-water fish
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Flour-dusted, shared fryer.

items.ja: 旨辛ささみスティック

items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Battered or breaded fried chicken with a spicy sauce — wheat in both the coating and, typically, the sauce.

items.en: Fried cheese wontons
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes

items.en: Salted cucumber sticks

items.en: Liver pâté with baguette

items.en: Cabbage with anchovy

items.ja: 海老とトマトのアヒージョ
items.en: Prawn and tomato in garlic oil
items.note: Prawns; served with bread as standard.

items.en: Garlic toast
items.note: Bread — wheat. Usually buttered, so dairy too.

items.en: Assorted prosciutto and cured hams
items.note: Cured pork. Dry-cured ham is normally just pork and salt, but the plate arrives with bread or grissini as standard — ask for it plain.

items.ja: サーモンカルパッチョ
items.en: Salmon carpaccio (à la carte portion)

items.en: Cheese board

items.en: Fresh (unfried) Vietnamese-style spring rolls
items.note: The wrapper for 生春巻き is rice paper, not wheat — genuinely different from a fried 春巻き. But the filling normally contains prawn and the dipping sauce is either hoisin (wheat) or nuoc cham (fish sauce), so this is 'ask', not 'gf', and not vegan as served.

items.ja: ムール貝の白ワイン蒸し

items.note: Shellfish. Steamed in wine, garlic and butter — no wheat in the classic recipe, but the bread comes with it and no ingredient list is published.

items.ja: フィッシュアンドチップス

items.ja: ナチョス〜贅沢トッピング〜
items.en: Nachos loaded with avocado, chilli beans, sour cream and jalapeño
items.note: Sour cream and usually melted cheese — not vegan. Corn tortilla chips carry no wheat as a rule, but Japanese-market brands often blend in wheat flour and the fryer is shared; ask.

items.en: Chips / french fries
items.note: Potato itself is wheat-free, but this kitchen fries panko-breaded salmon, karaage and beer-battered fish — a shared fryer means shared gluten.

items.en: Caprese — tomato and mozzarella
items.note: Fresh cheese. Tomato, cheese, oil and basil carry no wheat, but no allergen line is published.

items.ja: ファーマーズバーニャカウダ
items.en: Farmer's bagna cauda — raw vegetables with warm anchovy-garlic dip
items.note: Anchovy and dairy in the dip — not vegan. Bagna cauda normally has no wheat; unverified here.

items.en: Seared tuna niçoise salad
items.note: Tuna and egg. Dressing undocumented; a 'seared' Japanese preparation often means a soy marinade.

items.en: House special salad

items.en: Italian salad

items.en: Four-cheese pizza

items.ja: ベーコンとほうれん草のピザ
items.en: Bacon and spinach pizza

items.note: Wheat dough and mozzarella.

items.en: Seafood pizza

items.ja: ベーコンとナスのトマトソース

items.note: Wheat pasta and pork.

items.ja: タリアテッレうにクリームソース

items.note: Wheat pasta, sea urchin, cream.

items.ja: 渡り蟹のトマトクリームソースリングイネ
items.romaji: watarigani no tomato cream sauce linguine
items.en: Linguine with blue swimmer crab in tomato cream sauce
items.note: Wheat pasta, crab, cream.

items.en: Lasagne
items.note: Pasta sheets, béchamel (wheat roux) and meat ragù.

items.ja: ベトナム風レモングラス チキングリル
items.en: Vietnamese-style grilled lemongrass chicken
items.note: Chicken. Vietnamese lemongrass marinades use fish sauce and often soy or oyster sauce — ask, and note fish sauce also rules out vegan.

items.ja: スペシャル肉と野菜のコンボ
items.romaji: special niku to yasai no combo
items.en: Special meat-and-vegetable combination plate
items.note: Contents not published. Mixed grills here carry at least one soy-glazed element — ask item by item.

items.en: Beef tongue with scallion and salt
items.note: Beef. A 塩 (salt) preparation is the better bet in a soy-heavy kitchen — negishio sauce is scallion, sesame oil, salt and lemon — but many versions add a splash of soy, and no ingredient line is published.

items.en: Beef steak
items.note: Beef. In a Japanese izakaya the steak sauce is normally soy-based; ask for it plain with salt.

items.ja: ハワイスタイルプープスペアリブ
items.en: Hawaiian-style pupu spare ribs
items.note: Hawaiian rib glazes are built on shoyu and often hoisin — wheat.

items.ja: 豚肉のタンドール焼き
items.en: Tandoor-baked pork
items.note: Pork in a yoghurt-and-spice marinade — dairy. Tandoori marinades are usually wheat-free, but this one is undocumented and the oven may be shared with naan.

items.ja: ローズマリーローストチキン
items.en: Rosemary roast chicken
items.note: Chicken. Herb-roasted meat is often free of wheat, but the pan jus is unstated.

items.ja: アスパラチキンチーズ
items.en: Chicken with asparagus and cheese
items.note: Chicken and dairy; preparation unstated — if it is rolled and breaded it is wheat, so ask.

items.ja: 自家製 柔らか本格ローストビーフ
items.en: House-made tender roast beef
items.note: The beef itself is just beef, but Japanese roast-beef sauce is a soy-and-onion gravy as standard — wheat. Ask whether it can be served with only salt and horseradish.

items.ja: ソーセージ盛り合わせ
items.en: Assorted sausages
items.note: Pork. Sausage binders often include wheat rusk or starch, and mustard aside the accompaniments are unstated.

items.en: Churrasco of lean beef — the house speciality, seared to concentrate the juices and carved at the table
items.note: Beef. Brazilian churrasco is traditionally seasoned with nothing but coarse salt, which would make it one of the safest things on this menu — but this kitchen publishes no seasoning statement and Japanese churrasco houses commonly brush a garlic-soy marinade on. Ask specifically whether the rub is salt only.

items.ja: レモンチェッロのティラミス
items.en: Limoncello tiramisu
items.note: Savoiardi sponge fingers are wheat; mascarpone and egg.

items.ja: フォンダンショコラ バニラアイスクリーム添え
items.romaji: fondant chocolat vanilla ice cream zoe
items.en: Chocolate fondant with vanilla ice cream
items.note: Cake flour, butter, egg, dairy ice cream.

items.ja: サントリープレミアムモルツ
items.en: Suntory The Premium Malt's beer
items.note: Barley malt — the name says so. Never gluten-free.

items.en: Shandy gaff — beer with ginger ale
items.note: Half beer, so barley malt.

items.en: Panaché — beer with lemonade
items.note: Half beer, so barley malt.

items.en: Red eye — beer with tomato juice
items.note: Half beer, so barley malt.

items.en: House wine by the glass, red or white; bottles from ¥2,750
items.note: Grape wine carries no gluten grain, but wines are commonly fined with isinglass, gelatin, casein or egg white and no producer is named.

items.ja: 焼酎（ロック/水割り/ソーダ割り/お湯割り）

items.note: The shop's own all-you-can-drink list names its shochu as 焼酎（甲類麦） — barley-based multiple-distilled shochu. 麦 is barley, a gluten grain, so the house shochu is not gluten-free. If you need a non-barley base you must ask for a specific bottle.

items.ja: チューハイ（ウーロンハイ／緑茶ハイ）
items.en: Shochu highball with oolong or green tea
items.note: The tea itself is a leaf infusion with no barley, but the house shochu base is 甲類麦 — barley.

items.ja: サワー（レモン／オレンジ／グレープフルーツ／ピーチ／カルピス）
items.en: Sours — lemon, orange, grapefruit, peach or Calpis
items.note: Same barley-shochu base. The Calpis version is also a dairy drink, so not vegan.

items.en: Cocktails — cassis, peach, lychee, gin and vodka bases with a long list of mixers
items.note: Gin and vodka can be grain-distilled; liqueurs vary. Ask for the base spirit if it matters. Some fruit liqueurs and creams also carry dairy.

items.en: Soft drinks — oolong tea, green tea, orange, grapefruit, Coca-Cola, ginger ale, tonic water, pineapple, cranberry
items.note: From ¥550. Note that the two teas offered are oolong and green — leaf teas with no barley in them, unlike 麦茶.

items.en: Two-hour all-you-can-drink — highballs, draught beer, wine, umeshu, shochu, sours, gin/vodka/liqueur cocktails and soft drinks; +¥550 per extra 30 min
items.note: The published contents include 生ビール, ビームハイボール (bourbon — a grain whiskey) and 焼酎（甲類麦）, all gluten grains. A coeliac on this plan is limited to the soft drinks and possibly the wine.

items.ja: 【本格シュラスコ6種含む全11品】2時間飲み放題付きコース

items.note: Per person, 2–80 people. Course contents are not itemised; the standing menu they are drawn from includes pizza, pasta and fried items, so assume wheat is on the table.

items.en: The shop's No.1 course — 14 dishes including four kinds of meat sushi and four steaks, with two hours of all-you-can-drink

tokyo_nikuudon_nikumeshi_jinza.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Transcribed from the shop's own Shibuya-branch menu sheet published on udon-jinza.com, file-dated 2025-10-31. Numbers in the item notes are the ticket-machine button numbers printed on that sheet ('メニュー表の番号は券売機の番号と対応しています'). Sizes: 中盛 1.5 balls +¥70, 大盛 2 balls +¥140.

The dashi is built on 煮干 (dried sardine) plus Maruo Jozosho soy sauce from Kagawa — so it is neither vegan nor wheat-free, and the same だし醤油 sits on the table.
